input.quote: 14.2 Upon creation and subject to payment of the applicable Fees, Customer owns each Deliverable created specifically for Customer. Vendor hereby assigns to Customer all worldwide right, title, and interest in those Deliverables and shall obtain equivalent assignments from its personnel.
input.rationale: The IP package meets the preferred position and runs in our favour. §14.1 confirms Customer ownership of Customer Data, Customer Confidential Information and independently developed IP, with no transfer to Vendor beyond a limited processing right. §14.2 vests Deliverables created for Customer in Customer with an express Vendor assignment and further-assurance/personnel-assignment obligations. §14.3 lets Vendor retain Vendor Technology (acceptable) but applies the §13.2 perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence (including modify, create derivative works, and contractor support) to embedded Vendor Technology, plus a disclosure duty and a bar on restrictive third-party material. §14.4 excludes joint ownership absent a signed instrument and limits feedback use to generalized, de-identified suggestions while preserving our unrestricted rights. §15.1 further blocks sale, advertising use, data commingling and model training without our consent. No assignment of Customer IP or data to Vendor and no unrestricted joint ownership, so no walk-away trigger. Minor, non-flagged points only: Deliverable ownership is conditioned on payment of Fees, and the §13.2 licence sublicensing right is expressed as permitting contractors to support the material rather than a general sublicence right.
